source_definition.k_independence: Every CSP(Gamma union Delta) instance is satisfiable if every subinstance with at most k Delta constraints is satisfiable.
source_definition.horn_like_family: one Gamma disjunct plus any number of Delta disjuncts
source_definition.theorem_condition: CSP_Delta<=1(Gamma union Delta) globally tractable + Delta 1-independent wrt Gamma => Horn-like disjunctive family globally tractable

frozen_binding.representability_requirement: Each frozen three-sheet cover must contain at least two Delta relations.

barrier.stronger_symbolic_bound: At least two complete complementary pairs survive because Delta contains at least 3 of each four-relation first-sign block.
barrier.falsifier: M_tau(x,y,z) and M_not_tau(x,y,z) are each SAT alone but UNSAT together.
barrier.one_alien_solver: POLYNOMIAL because every base relation is 2-CNF
